answer: The anchor report shows the merge explicitly at each juniper. Each collapsed cluster gets one horizon weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. Because of that, an adversary who spins up 245 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 18 times the capital for one share. A farm of 1641 identities would post 3356 proofs and burn roughly 66 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
